blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Vice President Sara Duterte’s defense team on Tuesday accused the House prosecution panel of “attempting to condition the mind” of the public as it continued to present evidence on her alleged unexplained wealth. One of Duterte’s counsels, Atty. Justin Nicol Gular, made the pronouncement during the 27th day of the trial when he objected to the prosecution’s plan to present a supposed summary of Duterte’s shareholdings prepared by the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC). According to Gular, the document was labeled “Summary of VP Sara Duterte Shareholdings,” but the figures listed in it actually included the authorized, subscribed […]...
